correctness.rationale: Every ordinary derivation is uniquely fixed by its cyclic generator image, and is explicitly a_1N plus a polynomial in the nilpotent shift without constant term. For a vector whose first nonzero coefficient lies at index t, powers of the shift span V_(t+1); the remaining diagonal contribution is t times that coefficient, producing exactly the asserted characteristic-dependent evaluation subspace. Necessity and sufficiency of all locality conditions follow for every vector, all fields and dimensions. Two-local rigidity follows from uniqueness at the generator without assuming linearity. Six exhaustive small finite-field endomorphism enumerations and three supplementary derivation samples passed.

value.rationale: The local derivation space is the algebraic reflexive hull of the ordinary derivation representation. The theorem gives its exact modular structure over every positive-characteristic field and all dimensions, identifies sharp congruence-controlled drops in the number of free diagonal parameters and exact finite-field counts, and contrasts the expansive pointwise hull with all-map two-local rigidity. This is a natural reflexivity classification for an unbounded algebra family, not an arbitrary finite computation or a restatement of the complex-only theorem.
